steps.speaker: Reporter A
steps.content: <size=32>Director Deren! Your assistant said that you accepted the DisCars' invitation to be a judge. Is that true? Five years ago, there were rumors that you severed ties with the academy. Does this prove that those rumors were false? Or were they true, but you reconciled now?</size>

steps.speaker: Reporter B
steps.content: After hearing rumors of your comeback, many of the hottest stars have expressed their desire to be in your new work. xx, xxx, and xxxxx even hinted that they have an "intimate relationship" with you. What are your thoughts?

steps.speaker: Seething Crowd
steps.content:
What's your schedule like, Director Deren? What genre are you choosing this time?
Rom-com? Action? Fantasy?

steps.speaker: Reporter C
steps.content: Those aren't important! Over here, Director! I care about your cinematic art the most!

steps.speaker: Reporter C
steps.content: Why did you stop making films five years ago? Have you lost your inspiration? Did you retreat from the public eye to hide that fact? Please tell us! Are you all out of talent, Director Deren?
The crowd edges even closer. The pair who had just escaped from the chaos is besieged by microphones, cameras, phones and hands... But no one notices the conspicuous blue critter close by.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Sigh... I didn't expect that to happen.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It's so noisy!!!
She scares back the crowd and steps in front of Deren.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Whether she's D or Deren, she's my director! What do you people want to do to her? Outta the way, outta the way! No one's allowed to bully a crew member of mine!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Our movie isn't finished yet! Don't get in the way of us winning the DisCars!!
The reporters freeze for a moment. They look around, then lower their heads. Only then do they notice the little girl who's only half of Deren's height.

steps.speaker: Reporters
steps.content: Your crew...

steps.speaker: Reporters
steps.content: Are you the new Deren Girl?!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh?
The crowd becomes even more ecstatic, their cheers instantly drowning out OwO's voice.

steps.speaker: Seething Crowd
steps.content:
So you are making a comeback!
Who's the male lead? Who are the investors?
<size=32>Which production studio are you working with? What about the distributor? We can...</size>

steps.speaker: Hysterical Film Star
steps.content: No...! The next Deren Girl ought to be me! Director Deren! I'll do anything you want! I'll be a big box office hit, I promise! You're my dream! Please choose me!!
A couple of hands that had been reaching out to Deren turn towards OwO, startling her.

steps.speaker: Seething Crowd
steps.content: This kid is way too young. Is she related to one of the investors? They hid her for five years, so she must have quite the background... Could she be from Paradeisos?!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: L-let go of me!

steps.speaker: Seething Crowd
steps.content: No, no, her clothes look so cheap. She's an Outlander... Hehe, and that accent...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: D... Director! Head back and find ${PlayerName}! I'll stop these oafs!
No response comes from behind.

steps.speaker: Seething Crowd
steps.content: And that weird thing on her head... I've never seen that in DisCity... It really is... Tsk tsk...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It's not a "weird thing"!

OwO hollers out and stomps on the toes of the reporter who had been groping the lion's head. As he kneels down in pain, she jumps up with the golden lion's head, does a somersault, and lands firmly on the reporter's back.
OwO is angry.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: No touchy! This is a lion's head! It's a treasure from my hometown! It should've debuted onstage at the DisCars! It's all your fault, you rude trolls!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: This is a lion dance costume from Goldionville! It took a long, long way to get here! You're not allowed to insult it!
The golden lion's head gleams majestically in the light, surveying the crowd in rage. The crowd shuts up and stares at the Outland girl.

Clad in not-so-glamorous clothes and with a strange prop on her head, she glares at everyone with uninhibited fury. At this moment, OwO couldn't be more out of place with the Walk of Fame, tearing at the seams of this opulent dream factory.
As if unable to digest her existence, Dillywood falls silent. A long time passes before someone speaks up again...

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Goldionville... I remember now... I saw that name on a Quinn trade list a few years back. It's a city-state on the continent across the sea. Even today, there are no direct routes to it. We don't even have pictures of it...

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Last year, an catastrophe broke out on that continent, and it sank to the bottom of the sea...

<size=30>The last ray of hope is gone. The lion's head dims, and OwO seems to have suddenly lost her body. She wants to loudly refute the claim, but can't open her mouth. She wants to cover her ears, but her hands are frozen mid-air. Her eyes are wide open, but she can't recognize a single face in front of her.</size>

How strange. Is the world so far away from her? She feels tremors underneath her feet. The city is collapsing. Someone drags her down. Voices fill her head again, and every word is like a roaring drum.

steps.speaker: Blurry Voices
steps.content: Did that continent sink? Oh, I guess it's normal that we didn't hear about it. It's such a small, faraway city-state after all... It's hard to get to and hard to trade with. This would've happened sooner or later...

steps.speaker: Blurry Voices
steps.content: That's why she picked her. How brilliant of Director Deren... Everything makes sense now! What a genius choice! A great tearjerker would be a box office legend and make for the perfect comeback piece. Director Deren! Let's talk about distribution!

steps.speaker: Blurry Voices
steps.content: Ahhh... Director Deren... What's wrong?

The buzzing crowd suddenly falls silent. The director's face turns ashen, as if she saw something terrifying. But OwO doesn't notice at all. She just wants to grab someone. She has so many questions to ask. Who can answer her...
Step aside! Step aside!

steps.speaker: Woman who barges in
steps.content: Director, I finally found you! After all these years... Quick, come back with me!
A glamorous woman pushes through the crowd, grabs Deren and tries to leave. OwO doesn't understand what's going on, but she subconsciously grabs onto the director's loose black coat.

steps.speaker: Woman who barges in
steps.content: Save your questions for the press conference. The director won't be taking any questions right now. You...

The fashionable woman looks down and sees the little girl. She looks at Deren, then notices the countless cameras around her. Experienced and savvy, she quickly suppresses her built-up rage and puts on a warm smile.

steps.speaker: Woman who barges in
steps.content: Oh... I hear you're the director's friend. I'm Director Deren's assistant. I help her handle all kinds of work at the studio. Come find me if you need anything.

steps.speaker: Woman who barges in
steps.content: What's your name, sweetie?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...OwO... My name is OwO...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I grew up in DisCity... My homeland is Goldionville... I know how to perform lion dancing... I want to make a movie and win a DisCar... and then...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I want... people in my hometown to see me perform lion dancing on TV...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...Did something happen... to my hometown?

steps.speaker: Director's Assistant
steps.content: Sigh... About your homeland, I have heard some news about it... I'm sorry.

steps.speaker: Director's Assistant
steps.content: But all your misfortunes are in the past. Now you're in DisCity, and you've met Director Deren. These are all blessings of fate.

steps.speaker: Director's Assistant
steps.content: We'll take care of you. Why don't you join Deren Film Studios? We'll help you win the DisCar you want. You'll become Dillywood's future star.
What is she saying? Before the countless cameras, the woman brims with compassion as she reaches out to wipe the dust from the girl's face.

steps.speaker: Director's Assistant
steps.content: What an adorable child. What you had to go through is heartbreaking. Your story will move everyone in DisCity.

steps.speaker: Director's Assistant
steps.content: Your homeland would be proud of you.
The woman reaches out to OwO, and the crowd applauds. "Go with her, child," the crowd chants. But OwO is frozen in place.

steps.speaker: Director's Assistant
steps.content: Come...
Slap!
Someone slaps away the hand reaching towards OwO, and pulls the girl into their arms. OwO recognizes the person.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...${PlayerName}?
Footsteps rush over from behind.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: What the **** are they doing to OwO? Leave her alone!

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: I'm sorry... Madam, OwO already has a film crew... She is the founder of My Best Cool Car Studios. Please don't... look down on her because she's a child.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: No, Stella, you can't come out... I know you're angry, but not now...
You glance at the last member to join the crew. Behind her are countless flashing cameras. Her anger has dissipated, but she now has a totally unfamiliar look on her face.

steps.speaker: Option
options: ...This isn't the script you gave me.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: Sigh... Get used to it. This is Dillywood. Practically anyone can change your script.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: That's fate for ya. It never goes the way you want. Everyone who comes must understand that they need to choose... how to keep the show going.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: Now's your turn, my little hero.
She bends down towards OwO. Her long shadow eclipsing the girl's vision. OwO can't help but shrink back.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: This is the Walk of Fame that makes all wishes come true. Fame, fortune, dreams, and opportunity... You're lucky enough to have a ticket in.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: Want to pre-order a DisCar? Which category do you want to win in? Who do you want to watch your movie?

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: I'm the legendary Director Deren. Come to Dillywood with me. I can make all this come true.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: No, its not!
She reaches out and grabs Deren's clothes.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I'm not going! I don't want those things! Can you please stay?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You said you'd help me make my own film. You said everyone will see my story. It's not finished yet. My wish hasn't come true yet!

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: ...My dear OwO, some films have happy endings, and some have sad endings. But there's one kind of ending that's the cruelest...

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: It's when the filmmaker can't detach themselves from their film, and dissolves to dust alongside it the moment they leave the theater.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: The length of a film is all that a person can "direct." If you want to keep directing the world after the film ends... Are you strong enough to do that? Do you really think it's possible?

OwO doesn't know how to answer. Her silence causes the crowd to stir. They don't understand what's happening. Why isn't this Outlander girl accepting the deal of a lifetime? How can she let this new masterpiece hang on the line?
You shield OwO as the microphones and cameras turn to her. Yet the legendary director just smiles and blocks them all. She puts on her hat and walks into the sea of flashing cameras.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: Enough... This is my big comeback. Why are all the cameras pointing at someone else?

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: This is the Walk of Fame, where dreams are made and shattered. Come, my big comeback press conference is this way. Let's forge the next dream together!

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: Those who cannot be part of this dream should go sleep somewhere else...

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: Some movies don't belong to this place.
